maddeler.e:
نخشوشن (form XII)
# نَخْشَوْشِنُ (naḵšawšinu) /nax.ʃaw.ʃi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
# نَخْشَوْشِنَ (naḵšawšina) /nax.ʃaw.ʃi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
# نَخْشَوْشِنْ (naḵšawšin) /nax.ʃaw.ʃin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
